stateDiagram

STOPPED_STATE

STOPPED_STATE : STOPPED_STATE

STOPPED_STATE : enter / #123; slider_motor_enable(false)#59; \nslider_speed_set(0)#59; #125;

ERROR_STATE

ERROR_STATE : ERROR_STATE

ERROR_STATE : enter / #123; slider_fault_handler()#59; #125;

state MOVING_OUT_STATE {

        OUT_RAMP_UP_STATE

        OUT_RAMP_UP_STATE : OUT_RAMP_UP_STATE

        OUT_RAMP_UP_STATE : enter / #123; slider_motor_enable(true)#59; \nslider_direction_set(SLIDER_DIRECTION_OUT)#59; \nspeed = SLIDER_MIN_SPEED#59; \nslider_speed_set(speed)#59; \nslider_start_timer(SLIDER_RAMP_INTERVAL_MS)#59; #125;

        OUT_RAMP_UP_STATE : TIMER_EXPIRED [speed < SLIDER_MAX_SPEED] / #123; speed += SLIDER_SPEED_STEP#59; \nslider_speed_set(speed)#59; \nslider_start_timer(SLIDER_RAMP_INTERVAL_MS)#59; #125;

        OUT_FULL_SPEED_STATE

        OUT_FULL_SPEED_STATE : OUT_FULL_SPEED_STATE

        OUT_FULL_SPEED_STATE : enter / #123; slider_speed_set(SLIDER_MAX_SPEED)#59; #125;

        OUT_RAMP_DOWN_STATE

        OUT_RAMP_DOWN_STATE : OUT_RAMP_DOWN_STATE

        OUT_RAMP_DOWN_STATE : enter / #123; slider_start_timer(SLIDER_RAMP_INTERVAL_MS)#59; #125;

        OUT_RAMP_DOWN_STATE : TIMER_EXPIRED [speed > SLIDER_MIN_SPEED] / #123; speed -= SLIDER_SPEED_STEP#59; \nslider_speed_set(speed)#59; \nslider_start_timer(SLIDER_RAMP_INTERVAL_MS)#59; #125;

}

state MOVING_IN_STATE {

        IN_RAMP_UP_STATE

        IN_RAMP_UP_STATE : IN_RAMP_UP_STATE

        IN_RAMP_UP_STATE : enter / #123; slider_motor_enable(true)#59; \nslider_direction_set(SLIDER_DIRECTION_IN)#59; \nspeed = SLIDER_MIN_SPEED#59; \nslider_speed_set(speed)#59; \nslider_start_timer(SLIDER_RAMP_INTERVAL_MS)#59; #125;

        IN_RAMP_UP_STATE : TIMER_EXPIRED [speed < SLIDER_MAX_SPEED] / #123; speed += SLIDER_SPEED_STEP#59; \nslider_speed_set(speed)#59; \nslider_start_timer(SLIDER_RAMP_INTERVAL_MS)#59; #125;

        IN_FULL_SPEED_STATE

        IN_FULL_SPEED_STATE : IN_FULL_SPEED_STATE

        IN_FULL_SPEED_STATE : enter / #123; slider_speed_set(SLIDER_MAX_SPEED)#59; #125;

        IN_RAMP_DOWN_STATE

        IN_RAMP_DOWN_STATE : IN_RAMP_DOWN_STATE

        IN_RAMP_DOWN_STATE : enter / #123; slider_start_timer(SLIDER_RAMP_INTERVAL_MS)#59; #125;

        IN_RAMP_DOWN_STATE : TIMER_EXPIRED [speed > SLIDER_MIN_SPEED] / #123; speed -= SLIDER_SPEED_STEP#59; \nslider_speed_set(speed)#59; \nslider_start_timer(SLIDER_RAMP_INTERVAL_MS)#59; #125;

}

%% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
%% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
state "." as ROOT.(InitialState)

STOPPED_STATE --> OUT_RAMP_UP_STATE : CMD_MOVE_OUT [!slider_is_at_out_stop()]

STOPPED_STATE --> IN_RAMP_UP_STATE : CMD_MOVE_IN [!slider_is_at_in_stop()]

STOPPED_STATE --> ERROR_STATE : MOTOR_FAULT

ERROR_STATE --> STOPPED_STATE : do

MOVING_OUT_STATE --> STOPPED_STATE : CMD_STOP

MOVING_OUT_STATE --> STOPPED_STATE : SENSOR_OUT_STOP

MOVING_OUT_STATE --> ERROR_STATE : MOTOR_FAULT

OUT_RAMP_UP_STATE --> OUT_FULL_SPEED_STATE : TIMER_EXPIRED [speed >= SLIDER_MAX_SPEED]

OUT_RAMP_UP_STATE --> OUT_RAMP_DOWN_STATE : SENSOR_OUT_SLOW

OUT_FULL_SPEED_STATE --> OUT_RAMP_DOWN_STATE : SENSOR_OUT_SLOW

MOVING_IN_STATE --> STOPPED_STATE : CMD_STOP

MOVING_IN_STATE --> STOPPED_STATE : SENSOR_IN_STOP

MOVING_IN_STATE --> ERROR_STATE : MOTOR_FAULT

IN_RAMP_UP_STATE --> IN_FULL_SPEED_STATE : TIMER_EXPIRED [speed >= SLIDER_MAX_SPEED]

IN_RAMP_UP_STATE --> IN_RAMP_DOWN_STATE : SENSOR_IN_SLOW

IN_FULL_SPEED_STATE --> IN_RAMP_DOWN_STATE : SENSOR_IN_SLOW

ROOT.(InitialState) --> STOPPED_STATE
